The structure of Ca2Mg2Ti2O8 (reduced formula CaMgTiO4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ti centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ca and Mg centers show nine-coordinate oxygen environments. Corner-sharing is observed between Ti octahedra, and Ti octahedra also share corners and faces with Ca and Mg coordination polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
